notes: Municipal boundaries are unchanged between these elections: all 342 European Netherlands municipalities are matched by name and province to their 2025 CBS codes. The map uses simplified 2025 land boundaries; inland and offshore water polygons are omitted for readability.
Population is the CBS figure on 1 January 2025, used consistently in both election views. Circle area represents population, not valid votes or eligible voters.

The 346 official voting-area records in each year—including the three Caribbean public bodies and non-resident votes—reconcile exactly with each national party vote total. All participating lists are retained.
Left–right shift compares aggregate vote shares under a fixed, editable party grouping. It is separate from the private nine-axis ideology scores and cannot establish individual voter movements.
Official local turnout can exceed 100% when people use a voter pass to vote outside their home municipality. These published local percentages are preserved.
